title: Felipe Vidal Santiago and the umbrella man on the grassy knoll
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Felipe Vidal Santiago and the umbrella man on the grassy knoll, about 1963 at Dealey Plaza, Dallas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean, you see Phil Fid Felipe Fidal Santiago on the Grassy Null.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that at Dealey Plaza in Dallas, where President John F. Kennedy was shot in 1963, you can see a man named Felipe Vidal Santiago on the grassy knoll, a small slope beside the motorcade route. In his telling this ties to the "umbrella man", a figure seen there holding an open umbrella, and to the House Select Committee, the congressional inquiry that later reexamined the killing. If true, it would put a specific, named person at the scene of the assassination.
